bio_en: Hamaspyur Mirzoyan, known as Khamas, was born in Aygestan, Van. During the period of Davo's betrayal in 1908, when most of Van's youth were jailed and the armed men had taken to the mountains, she and her friends were the only link between the activists hidden in town and the bands in the mountains. In 1910 she went to Constantinople to study at the Dprotsaser girls' school, graduating with distinction in 1913. From 1921 she taught in Constantinople's national schools and died of tuberculosis in the National Hospital on 10 November 1936.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year from Hairenik 19 Jan 1937 (Azdarar of 20 November).
